response: ["The licensed guideline corpus contains no recommendation for the term 'NEV'.","The 7-point checklist triggers suspicion of melanoma.","Guidance for melanoma (MEL) is retrieved and applicable when the checklist triggers melanoma suspicion.","Surgical excision with histologically negative margins is the recommended first‑line treatment for primary cutaneous melanoma of any thickness.","Surgical excision with histologically negative margins is also the recommended first‑line treatment for melanoma in situ.","Surgical margins for melanoma should be based on tumor thickness.","Sentinel lymph node biopsy should be performed before wide excision of the primary melanoma when indicated.","Sentinel lymph node biopsy should be performed in the same operative setting as wide excision whenever possible.","When melanoma is suspected, the whole lesion should be completely excised with a narrow margin of 1–3 mm to allow histological diagnosis.","Incisional biopsies can be performed on large lesions such as facial lentigo maligna, acral lesions, and genital lesions.","The recommendation for complete excision with a narrow margin has a consensus rate of 100% (21/21).","The recommendation for complete excision with a narrow margin is based on consensus from 21 experts."]
